entity: Vermont private-sale gun background checks under its universal-check law
what_we_add: 77 checks in 2022, 0.17 per 100 dealer checks, last of the 10 law states (median 2.2), and the no-law median 0.10
why: WCAX and VTDigger name Vermont and report the same finding in words: strikingly few private-sale checks despite the law (48 in 2017, 90 in 2018, flat into 2019). No source has the 2022 count, the per-100-dealer-checks rate, or the last-of-10-states ranking.
